name: fskill
description: Engineering workflow skills for Codex. Twenty skills in five groups. Invocation is explicit: /name or $name.

interface.longDescription: fskill packages twenty engineering skills in five groups: decide, build, ship, read and write, and leave something the next session can use. Enter a skill with /name or $name. A similar word does not start that workflow.
defaultPrompt: Use fskill think to plan this change
Use fskill check to review this diff
Use fskill hunt to debug this failure
